text: That is not good and signifies poor quality. I have used this item for two weeks and already the fry basket coating is chipping off.  That is not good and signifies poor quality.  I spray with a non-stick spray with every use and I use a wash cloth or soft bristle brush made for cleaning non-stick surfaces.  In another month, there will be no non-stick surface left.  Then what?
